scope: Public Row/Column/Flex/Flexible/Expanded/Spacer options and their retained consumers in incular-widgets, delegating distribution to incular-layout's layout_flex. Row and Column stay separate public surfaces over one retained Flex kind. This ledger covers only this family; it does not claim whole-codebase completeness.
